comment: The plugin publishes no source; everything here was read from the manual at version 2.1 revision 2. The clock thresholds are 2.0V high and 0.1V low, and the phase-mode rule is above 9V then below 1V. The Lock parameter of each block and the menu-only Swing and Gate Length parameters have no census position, so they are left untagged. The manual's figure of 16 note blocks does not match this build, which configures 12 (params 0 to 119, ten per block).
